testResults.name: focused-corpus-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/knowledge/test_corpus.py tests/thesis/knowledge/test_search.py
testResults.result: 52 corpus tests + 28 search tests (T166 layer unbroken) covering the pinned front-matter contract, the dependency-free YAML-subset parser with precise MetadataError cases, deterministic front-matter rendering with round-trip equality, typed link/relationship validation with backlinks/superseded_by/contradictions accessors, corpus loading from a fixture tree with a supersession chain and a contradiction, duplicate-id detection, Git revision capture via a fake subprocess, and validate() problem listing

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite
testResults.result: 2155 passed at wave edit freeze (13 skipped performance benchmarks, 1 xfailed audit marker); the two remaining ruff F841 findings live in the concurrently-owned T214 experiment scripts, not in this task's files

testResults.name: lint-and-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/thesis/knowledge tests/thesis/knowledge && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check src/thesis/knowledge tests/thesis/knowledge && uv run --extra dev ty check src/thesis/knowledge
testResults.result: ruff check, ruff format --check, and ty clean on the knowledge package after integration hardening (ty-safe test builders, no ignore-comment suppressions)

limitations: Curation and publication remain explicit Git operations performed by the operator; no Git-write automation exists yet by design (AC3)
